high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified account "manushi_chhillar." The post features a magazine cover titled "The Peacock Magazine," dated April/May/June 2024. The cover showcases a woman dressed in an elaborate, intricately embroidered traditional Indian bridal outfit. She is seated on what appears to be a boat, with a scenic background that includes water and a cityscape in the distance. The woman is adorned with heavy jewelry, including a large necklace with multiple layers of pearls and stones, and a matching headpiece.
